what_happened: orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh exits 126 for this task: skill-base.sh:390 exports the whole state.json record as TASK_DATA, but this record is 164849 B, above Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN (131072 B, 32 pages). Every exec() after that export fails with E2BIG (observed on jq at skill-base.sh:608 and head at task-lookup-lib.sh:68/71). Reproduced directly: a 120000 B env var execs fine, 140000 B fails with the identical message. The bulk is .audit_verdict (158190 B of the 164849 B), a duplicate-detection blob carrying a verdict row per other task, so it grows with the task count. Deterministic, not transient -- re-dispatch cannot clear it. Task #518 (130477 B) is already over the same threshold.

Confirmed via grep that plan-format.md's existing [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] convention already closes the dynamic decision-gate-bypass case and is already excluded from PHASE_STATUS_OPEN_ALT, so the fix needs no new prose 'disposition' field -- only a narrower enterable-marker alternation (excluding BLOCKED) plus a new Depends-on parser (confirmed: phase-level Depends on is prose-only today, no existing parser anywhere).

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification under-verification check caught both non-final phases naming a hand-picked suite subset instead of suite_selection_select's complete output; corrected both to the verbatim full lists before the plan was accepted. The check turned an honest-looking guess into a measured claim at authoring time rather than at implementation time.

The dispatch Description's cited selector line number (orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh:2393) had drifted; live it is 2453. The research report had already caught it; the plan records the correction explicitly in a Premise Re-Validation section. Every other carried figure re-checked and confirmed unchanged, including source/deploy byte-identity via diff -q.
